sources.snippet: Model Description Qwen3-1.7B is a 1.7-billion-parameter general-purpose language model from the Qwen team at Alibaba Cloud. Part of the Qwen3 series, it is designed to deliver strong language understanding, reasoning, and generation while being small enough for efficient deployment on a wider range of devices.
